judge_panel.matching_evidence:
[mathematical] The evaluation metric is described as MAE but defined and reported as MSE

Section 3.1 says “the relative difference in mean absolute error (MAE) is reported,” but Eq. (10) defines
\[
\Delta MSE(\%)=
\frac{MSE_{\text{FastCentNN}}-MSE_{\text{CentNN}}}{MSE_{\text{CentNN}}}\times100,
\]
and the tables use the heading \(\Delta MSE(\%)\).

Why it matters: MAE and MSE are different quantities and can lead to different conclusions about clustering quality.

Concrete fix: If the experiments used MSE, change “mean absolute error (MAE)” to “mean squared error (MSE).”
judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer specifically flags the MAE-versus-MSE inconsistency in Section 3.1 and ties it to Eq. (10) and the tables. This directly matches the injected methods/results inconsistency.
